scope: Fairphone 6 (FP6), Fairphone Android 16 target source and the selected EU stock firmware
claim_boundary: A published repository and an observed branch commit establish source availability only. They do not establish compliance with the licences of consumed files, reproducibility, binary equivalence, ABI compatibility, load success or suitability of a Pixel-specific patch.

fairphone_manifest.verification: HTTPS Gerrit REST/Gitiles observation; immutable project commits were resolved from each effective branch on 2026-09-13. Signature verification and repo manifest -r remain builder-sync checks.

fairphone_device_configuration.build_entry_point: RECOMPILE_KERNEL=1 bash kernel_platform/build/android/prepare_vendor.sh fps consolidate; then bash build.sh dist --target_only

lineage_reference.role: Reference-only source for module ordering, extraction categories, init/fstab and candidate VINTF declarations; it is not a DiamaneOS base and does not prove stock or GrapheneOS compatibility.
lineage_reference.stock_blob_note: Its proprietary-files.txt says unpinned blobs are from FP6.QREL.16.104.0. Treat that list as a US-region reference and candidate allowlist only; re-derive every retained path and fixup against the selected EU stock input and GrapheneOS-derived framework.

selected_stock.installed_observation: Android 16 / SDK 36 / 2026-08-05 security patch / locked green user build
selected_stock.raw_partition_hashes: not collected while the stock device remains locked
selected_stock.generator_role: Authoritative EU factory-package extraction input; a future OTA source requires its own exact verification. The matching phone is a runtime verifier and optional source only for ordinary readable mounted files.

published_binary_packages.role: Historical reference only; never substitute these QREL.16.61.0 files for the selected EU QREL.16.100.0 generator input.

proprietary_input_strategy.supplemental_source: Matching locked stock phone for runtime declarations and ordinary readable mounted files only
device_unique_exclusions: modemst, fsg, fsc and other modem NV/EFS
proprietary_input_strategy.generation_rule: Write and verify a temporary generated tree, provenance inventory and integrity report before atomically replacing the prior valid output. Reject unexpected versions, hashes, missing files and unrelated substitutions.
proprietary_input_strategy.minimization_rule: Use an explicit allowlist and demonstrated dependency closure. Remove or adapt the complete init/VINTF/permission/feature/SELinux/client path for an omitted active component; never hand-edit generated output.
proprietary_input_strategy.open_source_replacement_rule: Prefer a maintained open-source implementation only after exact licence obligations, maintenance ownership, ABI/API compatibility, security properties, power/performance and actual hardware behavior pass. Do not replace hardware-backed protection with a weaker software fallback.

regional_support_strategy.desired_shape: One product only if stock comparison and device evidence establish a safe common set; otherwise isolate and bind regional variants.
comparison_scope: boot, vendor, ODM and kernel-module images
regional_support_strategy.selection_rule: A regional delta may use only an observed trustworthy hardware or boot SKU property, never locale, language, timezone or location.
regional_support_strategy.validation_resource: Second maintainer in the US plans to supply an actual US-region FP6 and independent device evidence.
regional_support_strategy.us_input_status: Official expected metadata recorded; archive not downloaded or independently verified by this project.
regional_support_strategy.claim_boundary: US remains unverified until the exact US stock comparison and candidate hardware/telephony matrix pass on that device.

blockers.finding: The verified EU QREL.16.100.0 factory archive is the selected exact extraction input. The public QREL.16.61.0 packages remain useful historical references but are not selected build inputs.
blockers.next_experiment: Implement the manifest-driven generator against the verified QREL.16.100.0 factory package, verify every retained file and dependency, and fail closed on any missing, mismatched or unrelated component.

blockers.finding: The reference device VINTF target level is 8, but the selected GrapheneOS branch-17 framework has not been built or checked against the FP6 Android 16 vendor matrix.
blockers.next_experiment: Assemble the minimal product, run assemble_vintf/checkvintf, boot it and run applicable VTS/VINTF checks without disabling enforcement or adding broad shims.

blockers.finding: Published generic KeyMint/Weaver integration and an SPU module do not prove the FP6's actual KeyMint, Gatekeeper, Weaver or StrongBox security levels.
blockers.next_experiment: Bind the actual services from the generated vendor tree, then test FBE metadata encryption, every user/profile credential path, reported security levels, attestation and rollback behavior on the device.

blockers.finding: Fairphone's kernel, module and device-tree sources are published, but the ACK ancestor, symbol/KMI match and closed-userspace UAPI coupling are not established.
blockers.next_experiment: Sync exact pins, record ACK ancestry, build the fps GKI and every module, compare ABI/KMI, then verify load lists and hardware smoke tests on the candidate.

blockers.finding: Camera kernel source is public, but the camera provider, algorithms, calibration and firmware remain prebuilt and the reference matrix carries a TCL-specific optional algorithm interface.
blockers.next_experiment: Extract the matching generated vendor set, bind provider/algorithm services and run full lens/mode/video/flash/camera2 and restart tests without copying a Pixel camera stack.

blockers.finding: QCRIL, QMI and IMS runtime components are proprietary and carrier behavior cannot be inferred from manifest presence.
blockers.next_experiment: Bind the matching radio/IMS services, validate VINTF, then run the declared dual-SIM/eSIM voice, SMS, data, VoLTE, VoWiFi and 5G matrix with provider variance.

blockers.finding: The reference tree defines A/B partitions and custom AVB keys, but source configuration is not evidence that locked custom-key boot, rollback and full/delta OTA recovery work.
blockers.next_experiment: Build with dummy keys, verify every image signature/rollback location, then perform authorized locked-device full, delta, interrupted-update and slot-recovery tests.

blockers.area: NFC generated userspace and build binding
blockers.finding: The selected stock VINTF names nfc-service-sec and the pinned reference maps sec_nfc.ko to vendor_dlkm, selecting the Samsung kernel path from the manifest candidates. Matching QREL.16.100.0 userspace inputs have not yet been generated from the verified stock archive.
blockers.next_experiment: Trace the matching generated vendor makefile and binary hashes, retain the Samsung path, reject unused NXP/ST driver candidates, then prove module load plus NFC/UICC behavior on the candidate.

blockers.finding: EU QREL.16.100.0 is the selected baseline. US QREL.16.104.0 is a comparison input, and the second maintainer plans to provide an actual US-region FP6, but no US stock delta or candidate-device result has been accepted.
blockers.next_experiment: Acquire and verify the exact US stock input, produce a file/partition/firmware/VINTF/carrier-policy delta against EU QREL.16.100.0, then run the candidate hardware and T-Mobile-oriented telephony matrix on the US device before claiming shared support.
